scope: Repeated tone/flash fixture; threshold-only real app import/analyze/export, 60 minutes includes 1000 cuts. Whole app tree RSS at 250ms, driver excluded. UI timings include Playwright overhead and two animation frames. Repeated UI targets use the recorded role or CSS selector mode; native click/fill and state assertions are unchanged. No OS cache purge, no human quality or cold-cache claim. Native file paths controlled by test.
